title: Per-user settings table and store (smallest part of REQ-138 needed for Count my open positions), migration only
items: Step 1 = CORE PROOF PLAN (read spec/requirements/REQ-081.md AC-5/AC-6 first): write in the PR body what the whole row 26m can and cannot prove. WITHOUT an open position: the standalone read (consider_positions=false) returns a figure equal to the =true figure for the same plan, the setting reads back per user, the labels and the cache key switch. NEEDS one real open position (owner action, not available: none on 2026-10-21 or 2026-10-26): Zerodha returns a DIFFERENT figure for =true vs =false, and a lower one when the position hedges. Those two stay UNPROVEN and AC-5 stays PARTIAL. This part proves its own core on the real DB: the migration applies through the CI database step (not by hand over the tunnel), the key is written for user_ref 'owner' and read back in a second connection.

FINDING (class 1 card defect, fix in this PR): spec/requirements/REQ-138.md body says the per-user settings store was added for the option chain in migration 0022, W-124. On main there is NO such store: main's 0022 is backend/ofo_app/alembic/versions/0022_strategy_versions.py, the head is 0026_strategy_deleted_at, and the store exists only in OPEN PR #509 (origin/build/W-124-a3-chain: 0022_user_settings.py revises 0021 and collides with main's 0022; user_setting_store.py; routes/user_settings.py). Correct that sentence in REQ-138 and work/W-168.md to name migration 0027 (W-154 row 26m-db) as the place, and note PR #509 must re-parent its migration. Not a deviation (Class 1).

Build the SMALLEST part of REQ-138's store in the shape it already has in PR #509, not a second shape: one table public.user_settings, PRIMARY KEY (user_ref, key), key a closed lower-case dotted word (CHECK), value JSONB, updated_at stamped by the guard trigger from the database clock (ADR-023), the guard refuses delete and any update except value, grants SELECT + INSERT(user_ref,key,value) + UPDATE(value) to the application role (ADR-048), an allow-list block added to ofo_assert_app_role_allowlist by the _load/_replaced_once pattern of backend/ofo_app/alembic/versions/0026_strategy_deleted_at.py:34-60, downgrade refuses while a row exists. Revision 0027_user_settings revises 0026_strategy_deleted_at. Take the hunks from `git show origin/build/W-124-a3-chain:<path>` and change ONLY what main forces (revision ids, the allow-list block number counted from main, no import of ofo_app.chain_push which is not on main).

user_setting_store.py: registry SETTINGS of key -> SettingSpec(default, allowed). Register exactly ONE key: 'margin.count_open_positions' = bool, default True (REQ-081 AC-5 on by default); allowed = type(value) is bool (the int 1 is refused). Do not register chain.strikes_each_side (PR #509 adds it when it re-parents) nor REQ-138's other keys (lots/quantity, expected-move days, OI expiries, manual P&L): those are row 40 (W-168), which then only ADDS keys and the Settings panel - record that overlap in the PR body. read() returns (value, is_default); a stored value no longer allowed reads as the default; write() upserts one key for the caller-supplied user_ref, never a hard-coded owner (REQ-138 AC-2; the single V1 user appears only in the caller, live_market.OWNER_REF, backend/ofo_app/live_market.py:47).

A migration is its own PR (runbook): this part is PR 1 of 3 and merges before 26m-b. Grep tests/ and tests_app/ for '0026_strategy_deleted_at' and update every head-revision or allow-list pin (finding measure-file-list-misses-shared-registries); list those files in the report.

Tests: tests_app/test_user_setting_store.py (default when no row; write then read; unknown key refused before any SQL; bool only; a stored non-bool reads as default; two user_refs never see each other's value; empty user_ref refused). tests_app/test_user_settings_allowlist_chain.py (the allow-list lists the new block, the application role has exactly the three grants, an update of user_ref or key and a delete are refused by the guard, downgrade refuses with a row). Mutation pins: guard allows delete, UPDATE granted on key, bool check weakened to int, default flipped to False.
core: Zerodha basket margin for the same real plan read twice - consider_positions=true (open positions counted) and consider_positions=false (this strategy alone) - through the product path POST /api/strategies/outcome, each shown with its own label (REQ-081 AC-5), while the Execute gate keeps reading consider_positions=true (REQ-081 AC-6, ADR-094).
proof: item 1 (core proof plan): with NO open position in the owner's account (none on 2026-10-21 nor 2026-10-26) the builder can prove only that the standalone read works (a recorded POST /margins/basket?consider_positions=false for the row-25 2-leg NIFTY plan returns 200 with the same final.total as =true, because nothing else is held), that the setting, the cache key and the label switch work, and that the Execute gate still sends =true. It CANNOT prove that Zerodha returns a different figure with a position held, nor that the position-aware figure may be lower: that needs one real open NIFTY position (owner-held, 1 lot) and is recorded as UNPROVEN until then (AC-5 stays PARTIAL, issue to be filed with --stage).
spec_basis: REQ-081 AC-5 "Count my open positions"; REQ-081 AC-5 "The choice is a per-user setting, on by default as in Sensibull."; REQ-081 AC-6 "The hard gate before the basket stays REQ-055 with the ADR-094 figure whatever this setting says"; ADR-099 "quantity or planned price changes - never on every tick."; ADR-094 "a negative difference counts as 0, never as a credit"; REQ-138 AC-2 "from the session, never a hard-coded owner"; REQ-138 AC-3 "Changing a setting that changes a number"; ADR-152 "Three exceptions still go to the owner one question at a time"
copy_from: none - searched REQ-081, margin, positions, settings in spec/technical-design/legacy-reuse.md; the store shape is taken from this repo's own open PR #509 (branch build/W-124-a3-chain: 0022_user_settings.py, user_setting_store.py), not from a legacy repo; reference only, not copied: app/api/routes/orders.py (algochanakya margins/import-positions, float money; this repo reads positions through ofo_app/kite_reads.py)

attack.text: The store never takes a user from itself: an empty or non-text user_ref is refused and two users' values stay apart
Only bool is allowed for margin.count_open_positions: 1, 'true', null are refused and a stored junk value reads as the default True
The application role cannot DELETE or UPDATE user_ref/key and the guard trigger refuses both
Downgrade refuses while a setting row exists
The allow-list text replacement fails loudly if main's previous block changed shape

standing.b: n/a: no CI step gains an import; the migration imports only alembic and the repo's earlier migrations like 0026
standing.c: n/a: no static detector added; head-revision pins are found by grep and updated
standing.d: applied: setting stated (row) -> value; absent (no row) -> default True; stored value no longer allowed -> default, never an error; user empty -> refused; unknown key -> refused; database unreadable -> the caller (26m-b) uses the default and logs the class, never a made-up figure

threat_model: in scope - a table the app role can over-write (user_ref/key change, delete), a second store shape beside PR #509, a migration number collision with PR #509's 0022, a hard-coded owner in the store, a wrong-type value read as true; out of scope - the margin read (26m-b) and every other REQ-138 key (row 40)
ci: kit ci.yml pytest + app-tests job (tests_app/test_user_setting_store.py, tests_app/test_user_settings_allowlist_chain.py, the head-revision pin tests); migration applied by the CI database step
